items.title: GDC State of the Game Industry report: 40% of developers are using generative AI for work
items.excerpt: Survey project lead Beth Elderkin lays bare the mood of the industry, the job market, and how people are making games
items.rationale: 15th annual GDC survey (2,600+ devs) puts gen-AI use at 40% — the headline industry data point of the week; GamesIndustry.biz version chosen over Game Developer/IGN coverage of the same report (brief assigns this story to games only).

items.title: Chinese Tech Giant Tencent Launches AI Companions For Gamers
items.excerpt: Meet the four anime girls who, hopefully, won't spy on you.
items.rationale: New product launch: Tencent ships AI companions that watch play and give advice — a new player-facing AI character format worth tracking for character/UX designers.

items.title: Apex Neural Rendering Challenges NVIDIA DLSS With Up To 2.4X Faster Frame Generation, 62% Lower VRAM Usage, And Broad GPU Support
items.excerpt: Apex Neural Rendering rivals NVIDIA DLSS with up to 2.4X faster frame generation, 62% lower VRAM usage, and beta support for older GPUs.
items.rationale: A new, vendor-neutral neural rendering/frame-gen tech with beta support for older GPUs — a distinct product from the DLSS 5 stories already run.

items.title: Ludo releases free, open-source toolbox that lets AI coding agents prepare game assets for engines
items.excerpt: Ludo.ai, the developer's companion for creating production-ready game assets, announced the Ludo Toolbox, a set of 32 free command-line tools that give coding agents the ability to prepare game assets for engines.
items.rationale: Follow-up with a new release: 32 free open-source CLI tools for agent-driven asset prep — directly usable in an art/asset pipeline tomorrow.

items.title: AI-native game development: Making games that can only be made with AI | GamesBeat Next 2026
items.excerpt: AI-native game development could unlock new kinds of games, with intelligent characters, dynamic worlds and gameplay built around AI.
items.rationale: Fresh GamesBeat Next session on designing games around AI (intelligent characters, dynamic worlds) — design-level perspective rather than tooling; rounds out outlet spread.

https://mobidictum.com/ludo-free-open-so.new_action: New release: Ludo Toolbox, a free open-source set of 32 command-line tools for AI coding agents (distinct from the 10-20 Ludo CLI launch)
